name: build-tam
tagline_zh: 输入你的理想客户画像，自动从 Crustdata、Dropleads、PDL 抓取公司和联系人。
tagline_en: Paste your ICP, get a deduped TAM list from Crustdata, Dropleads & PDL—no manual sourcing, 3 hours saved.
desc_en: Build a Total Addressable Market list by sourcing accounts and contacts from providers like Crustdata, Dropleads, and PDL.
why_zh: 同类工具只给名单，它帮你跨源去重并合并联系人，直接可用，省掉你清洗数据的功夫。
why_en: Unlike list-only tools, it cross-deduplicates and merges contacts across sources, ready for outreach.
